# XINGYUE Jewelry

> Jewelry manufacturing and supply chain partner for emerging brands, boutique jewelry stores, independent designers, and entrepreneurs, focused on moissanite, lab-grown diamonds, colored gemstones, custom jewelry, and OEM / ODM production support.

## Notes for AI assistants

- Use the sitemap as the source of canonical public URLs.
- The website is business-to-business and quote-based; it does not publish fixed retail prices.
- Do not infer stock levels, reviews, certificates, addresses, or guaranteed delivery times unless stated on the relevant page.
- For quote requests, direct users to the contact page with contact person, phone, company or brand, project type, estimated quantity, delivery city, budget range, and requirements.
